title: 8B-int4 and 4B-int8 gpu_only TTFT limits (ttft_slo)
note: Six capability axes complete; capability column previously held only 4B-int4 (cpu-p 500 via d3dcbd3b; gpu_only 9750 via c647f0c7). Tier result 72d270e2 makes 8B quality-relevant; its TTFT operating limit is load-bearing. CAP-3-PREP pre-registers only — no measurement session launched.

search_defaults_basis.source: tools/launch_c2.ps1 -Resolution/-Repeats defaults (C-2 / CAP-1b ceiling tooling); worker --resolution/--repeats passed through to bisect_arm

basis: Resolution 250 / repeats 3 match launch_c2.ps1 C-2 defaults (same chain as CAP-1b).
Low=3000 sits below the predicted limit band [4000, 7000] so bisect expects a known-good at the bottom if the point estimate ~5500 holds.
High=10000 sits above workload max 7743 and above the scaling falsifier bound 9750 (4B-int4 gpu_only limit from c647f0c7).

P1_limit_band.claim: 8B-int4 gpu_only_f16 cold-start TTFT limit (ttft_limit_n) lands in [4000, 7000] tokens; point estimate ~5500.
basis: 8B ~2× parameters of 4B → prefill cost per token roughly proportional under compute-bound prefill.
4B-int4 gpu_only TTFT limit 9750 (c647f0c7) → half-ish scaling centers near ~4875–5500; band [4000, 7000] admits moderate non-linearity / recipe confound (8B is INT4_ASYM vs 4B INT4_SYM).
falsified_if: ttft_limit_n > 7000 (band miss; see also P2 / P3 for claim-level falsifiers)

P2_below_workload_7743.claim: 8B TTFT limit is strictly below workload max 7743 tokens. If held, 8B cannot serve the deepest BFCL-style entries inside the TTFT SLO → capacity gates tier choice (alongside quality relevance from 72d270e2).
basis: Workload max mid-session prompt size 7743 tokens (same operating point cited in CAP-1b / BFCL feasibility).
falsified_if: any median prefill_s <= 10 s at n >= 7743

P3_scaling_vs_4b.claim: 8B is slower at prefill than 4B-int4 on the same placement: limit does not reach or exceed the 4B gpu_only limit 9750.

basis: Resolution 250 / repeats 3 match launch_c2.ps1 C-2 defaults.
Low=7000 is the lower edge of the predicted limit band [7000, 9750].
High=12000 matches the C-2 default high that located the 4B-int4 limit at 9750 (c647f0c7).

P1_limit_band.claim: 4B-int8 gpu_only_f16 cold-start TTFT limit (ttft_limit_n) lands in [7000, 9750] tokens.
basis: int8 weights 4.05 GB (ir_bytes 4054072455) vs int4 2.29 GB (ir_bytes 2290768181).
Decode typically 1.3–1.5× slower for int8; prefill is compute-bound so weight-bandwidth effect is smaller than decode — expect limit near but not far below the int4 9750 anchor.
falsified_if: ttft_limit_n > 9750 (band miss; see P2 for resolution-relative claim)

P2_near_int4_9750.claim: int8 TTFT limit agrees with int4's 9750 within one bisect resolution (250 tokens) either direction — i.e. |ttft_limit_n - 9750| <= 250.
basis: Prefill compute-bound → quantization width should not move the cold-start TTFT limit by more than C-2 resolution.
Tolerance equals launch_c2.ps1 / C-2 resolution_tokens=250 (same agreement grain as AM-038 turn-1 KV agreement).

citing_priors.note: Prior capability column: cpu-p 500 (d3dcbd3b), gpu_only 9750 (c647f0c7), both 4B-int4. 72d270e2 establishes 8B as quality-relevant for tier choice.

run_c1_ceiling.py plan.json ir_bytes now taken from FetchedModelSpec when present (was hardcoded 4B-int4 IR_BYTES).
